prompt: Ilse cannot decide ___ to repaint her bedroom herself or ask a painter.
explanation_ru: Перед инфинитивом и при выборе из двух вариантов («красить самой или нанять») нужен whether; if с to-инфинитивом не употребляется.

prompt: We argued about ___ the school trip should go ahead in the rain.
explanation_ru: После предлога about косвенный вопрос вводится словом whether («ли»); if после предлога не ставится.

prompt: Taro will cook fish tonight, ___ his guests like it or not.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «независимо от того, ... или нет» строится с whether ... or not; остальные союзы здесь не подходят по смыслу.

prompt: Nobody knows whether the shop will be open on Sunday, so Kasimir is going to phone first.
answer: Nobody knows whether the shop will be open on Sunday, so Kasimir is going to phone first.
accepted_answers: Nobody knows whether the shop will be open on Sunday, so Kasimir is going to phone first.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: after know в косвенном вопросе «ли» передаётся словом whether, и will здесь допустим, потому что это не условное придаточное.

prompt: It does not matter if the weather is good or bad. We will have the picnic. → Whether …
answer: Whether the weather is good or bad, we will have the picnic.
accepted_answers: Whether the weather is good or bad, we will have the picnic.
Whether the weather is good or not, we will have the picnic.
explanation_ru: Значение «независимо от того, ... или ...» передаёт whether ... or; после него Present Simple.

prompt: Ayodele's parents let him go camping ___ he takes his phone and calls every night.
explanation_ru: On condition that значит «при условии, что»: разрешение зависит от выполнения условия.

prompt: Zinaida got the weekend job under condition that she finished her exams first.
answer: Zinaida got the weekend job on condition that she finished her exams first.
accepted_answers: Zinaida got the weekend job on condition that she finished her exams first.
explanation_ru: Правильное выражение — on condition that (а не under condition): типичная ошибка при переводе «при условии».

prompt: Holly goes running every morning, ___ she has a cold.
explanation_ru: Even if означает «даже если»: она бегает независимо от простуды. Only if и provided сделали бы простуду условием.

prompt: My sister will buy the red coat. It does not matter if it costs a lot. → My sister will buy the red coat even if …
answer: My sister will buy the red coat even if it costs a lot.
accepted_answers: My sister will buy the red coat even if it costs a lot.
My sister will buy the red coat even if it costs a lot of money.
My sister will buy the red coat even if it is expensive.
explanation_ru: Even if вводит условие, которое не мешает результату; после него — Present Simple (costs), не will.

prompt: You can take a free sticker only if you (to finish) the whole quiz.
explanation_ru: После only if ставится Present Simple (finish) или Present Perfect; will после if и only if не употребляется.

prompt: ___ the manager agrees will the shop change its opening hours.
explanation_ru: Only if в начале предложения требует инверсии в главной части (will the shop change); так «только если менеджер согласится».

prompt: Seun's dad says Seun may go to the football camp, but there is one condition: his school marks must be good this term.
options: Seun can go to the camp only if his marks are good this term.
Seun can go to the camp even if his marks are bad this term.
Seun can go to the camp only if his marks will be good this term.
Seun can go to the camp in case his marks are good this term.
explanation_ru: Условие единственное, поэтому нужен only if + Present Simple; even if отменяет условие, in case означает предосторожность, а will после if неверно.

prompt: Unless you don't hurry, we will miss the train.
answer: Unless you hurry, we will miss the train.
accepted_answers: Unless you hurry, we will miss the train.
If you don't hurry, we will miss the train.
explanation_ru: Unless уже содержит отрицание («если не»), поэтому unless ... don't — двойное отрицание. Нужно unless you hurry или if you don't hurry.

prompt: Odile always packs a spare key ___ she loses the first one.
explanation_ru: In case — это предосторожность («на случай, если»): запасной ключ берут заранее, а не после потери.

prompt: The school lets students use phones in the yard, provided they (to switch) them off in class.
explanation_ru: После provided ставится Present Simple (switch), а не will: «при условии, что они выключают».

prompt: Would you mind if I (to open) the window? It is so hot in here.
explanation_ru: В вежливой просьбе после would you mind if используется прошедшая форма (opened) с настоящим значением.

prompt: I would really appreciate it if you ___ me a lift to the station tomorrow.
explanation_ru: В вежливой просьбе после I would appreciate it if нужно could/would + глагол; will после if — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Do you think it would be OK if I will leave work an hour early on Friday?
answer: Do you think it would be OK if I left work an hour early on Friday?
accepted_answers: Do you think it would be OK if I left work an hour early on Friday?
Do you think it would be OK if I leave work an hour early on Friday?
explanation_ru: После would be OK if в вежливом вопросе нельзя ставить will; нужна форма left (вежливая) или leave.

prompt: Please close the door. → It would be nice if you …
answer: It would be nice if you closed the door.
accepted_answers: It would be nice if you closed the door.
It would be nice if you could close the door.
It would be nice if you would close the door.
explanation_ru: В вежливой просьбе после it would be nice if идут прошедшая форма, could или would, но не will.

prompt: Siv's new colleague plays loud music all day. Siv wants to ask him politely to turn it down.
options: I would appreciate it if you turned the music down a little.
I would appreciate it if you will turn the music down a little.
I would appreciate it if you would turned the music down a little.
I would appreciate it if you are turning the music down a little.
explanation_ru: В вежливой просьбе после I would appreciate it if нужна прошедшая форма (turned); will, would turned и continuous неверны.

prompt: I'd be very grateful if you (to send) me the contract today, because my bank closes at five.
explanation_ru: После I'd be grateful if в вежливой просьбе используется sent, could send или would send, но не will send.

prompt: What (you / to do) if your boss asked you to work every Saturday?
explanation_ru: Вопрос о воображаемой ситуации: if + Past Simple (asked), в главной части would + подлежащее + инфинитив: would you do.

prompt:
— Imagine you found a wallet full of cash outside the post office. What (you / to do)?
— I (to take) it to the police, of course.
— Even if nobody (to see) you?
— Even then. I could not sleep otherwise.
explanation_ru: Воображаемая ситуация: вопрос — would you do, результат — would take, а условие after even if — Past Simple (saw).

prompt: How would you feel if your neighbours ___ a noisy motorbike and parked it under your window?
explanation_ru: В вопросе о воображаемой ситуации после if нужен Past Simple (bought); would и will после if — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Imagine the lift in your building stopped working for a week. How would you carry the shopping? → How would you carry the shopping if …
answer: How would you carry the shopping if the lift in your building stopped working for a week?
accepted_answers: How would you carry the shopping if the lift in your building stopped working for a week?
How would you carry the shopping if the lift stopped working for a week?
explanation_ru: Вопрос с воображаемым условием: if + Past Simple (stopped), а would стоит только в главной части.

prompt: Honestly, would you be happy if you worked only three days a week but earned much less?
answer: Honestly, would you be happy if you worked only three days a week but earned much less?
accepted_answers: Honestly, would you be happy if you worked only three days a week but earned much less?
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: в воображаемом вопросе after if стоит Past Simple (worked, earned), в главной части — would you be.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: Were the café to raise its prices, we would go somewhere else.
accepted_answers: Were the café to raise its prices, we would go somewhere else.
explanation_ru: Это инверсия от «If the café were to raise its prices»: Were + подлежащее + to + глагол, в главной части would + инфинитив.

prompt: It is very unlikely, but the bank may refuse our loan. In that case we will have to sell the car. → If the bank were to …
answer: If the bank were to refuse our loan, we would have to sell the car.
accepted_answers: If the bank were to refuse our loan, we would have to sell the car.
If the bank were to refuse our loan, we'd have to sell the car.
explanation_ru: Were to выражает маловероятное будущее; в главной части would + инфинитив (would have to sell).

prompt: My family lives here, so if the company (to offer) me a job in Dubai tomorrow, I (not / to take) it.
explanation_ru: Маловероятное будущее: were to offer (или Past Simple offered) и would not take; will здесь не подходит.

prompt: Gethin's village team has almost no chance of winning the cup, but the coach likes to dream.
options: If we were to win the cup, the club would build a new pitch.
If we would win the cup, the club would build a new pitch.
If we were to win the cup, the club will build a new pitch.
If we are to win the cup, the club would build a new pitch.
explanation_ru: Шанс почти нулевой, поэтому используется were to + would; would после if и will в главной части — ошибки.

prompt: My flat is far from the station. If it (to be) closer, I could walk to work.
explanation_ru: Ситуация нереальна сейчас: после if нужна форма were/was, в главной части could + инфинитив.

prompt: If Vusi lived next to the gym, he ___ there every morning before work.
explanation_ru: В главной части второго условного после modal нужен инфинитив без to: might go; can и формы went неверны.

prompt: If Jorge would have a bigger room, he could invite his friends for a film night.
answer: If Jorge had a bigger room, he could invite his friends for a film night.
accepted_answers: If Jorge had a bigger room, he could invite his friends for a film night.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить would: нужен Past Simple (had). Would и could стоят только в главной части.

prompt: Dariusz's farm is far from any town and has no phone signal. If it (to have) a signal, he could video-call his sister every evening. If the farm (to be) closer to the village, his friends might (to visit) more often. It is a quiet life, but he says he would not change it.
explanation_ru: После if в нереальных условиях — Past Simple (had, were/was), а после could/might — инфинитив (visit).

prompt: My laptop is making a strange noise. If I (to be) you, I would take it to a shop.
explanation_ru: В совете «на твоём месте» используется только If I were you, а не was.

prompt: If I was you, I would not pay for that online course.
answer: If I were you, I would not pay for that online course.
accepted_answers: If I were you, I would not pay for that online course.
If I were you, I wouldn't pay for that online course.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом совете If I were you употребляется were, а не was.

prompt: You should tell Mr Banerjee about the leak. → If I were you, …
answer: If I were you, I would tell Mr Banerjee about the leak.
accepted_answers: If I were you, I would tell Mr Banerjee about the leak.
If I were you, I'd tell Mr Banerjee about the leak.
explanation_ru: Совет оформляется как If I were you + would + инфинитив.

prompt: Kalani loves basketball. If she (to be) taller, she (to join) the school team.
explanation_ru: Нереальная ситуация сейчас: if + were/was, в главной части would + инфинитив.

prompt: Tobias works from home, and his flat is tiny. If it (to be) bigger, he (to buy) a proper desk. If his sister (to live) nearby, she could lend him one. For now he works at the kitchen table.
explanation_ru: Нереальные условия: if + were/was и Past Simple (lived), в главной части would + инфинитив.

prompt: If the tickets ___ cheaper, more students would come to the school concert.
explanation_ru: После if в нереальном условии нужна форма were; would после if ставить нельзя.

prompt: If Beata were less shy, she would join the debating club.
options: Beata was shy, so she did not join the debating club.
Beata is not shy, so she joins the debating club.
Beata is shy, so she does not join the debating club.
Beata is shy, but she joins the debating club.
explanation_ru: Второе условное описывает нереальное настоящее: Beata is shy и does not join. Прошедшая форма were передаёт настоящее время.

prompt: Ayaan stares at an old photo of his first office. 'What if I (not / to move) to this city ten years ago? My life would be completely different.'
explanation_ru: Речь о прошлом событии, которое нельзя изменить: what if + Past Perfect (hadn't moved).

prompt: 'We took the shortcut and got lost. What if we ___ the main road instead?' Bastien asked.
explanation_ru: О прошлом событии, которое нельзя изменить, after what if нужен Past Perfect (had taken).

prompt: Dad laughs at the cartoon. 'What if cats (to rule) the world? They would just sleep all day.'
explanation_ru: Фантазия о невозможном: what if + Past Simple (ruled), а не настоящее или will.

prompt: 'What if I would have asked for her number at the party last night?' Jaden wonders.
answer: 'What if I had asked for her number at the party last night?' Jaden wonders.
accepted_answers: 'What if I had asked for her number at the party last night?' Jaden wonders.
explanation_ru: После what if о прошлом нужен Past Perfect (had asked); would have после what if — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Rasa and her brother look at a photo of the house their grandparents sold years ago. Rasa imagines a different past.
options: What if we keep the house? We could still spend every summer there.
What if we would have kept the house? We could still spend every summer there.
What if we had kept the house? We could still spend every summer there.
What if we will keep the house? We could still spend every summer there.
explanation_ru: Продажа дома — факт прошлого, поэтому what if + Past Perfect (had kept); другие варианты строятся неверно.

prompt: I'd prefer it if you (not / to park) in front of my gate, please. My van needs to get out.
explanation_ru: После I'd prefer it if, когда просьба относится к другому лицу, нужен Past Simple (didn't park).

prompt: Please don't call me at work. → I'd prefer it if you …
answer: I'd prefer it if you didn't call me at work.
accepted_answers: I'd prefer it if you didn't call me at work.
I'd prefer it if you did not call me at work.
I would prefer it if you didn't call me at work.
I would prefer it if you did not call me at work.
explanation_ru: После I'd prefer it if с другим подлежащим используется Past Simple в отрицательной форме (didn't call).

prompt: Your room is a mess. It's high time you (to clean) it.
explanation_ru: После it's high time идёт Past Simple (cleaned), хотя речь о настоящем.

prompt: You must start saving money. → It's high time you …
answer: It's high time you started saving money.
accepted_answers: It's high time you started saving money.
It is high time you started saving money.
It's high time you started to save money.
It's high time you began saving money.
explanation_ru: После it's high time используется Past Simple (started) с настоящим значением.

prompt: Zoltan has never driven a car, but he talks as if he ___ a racing driver.
explanation_ru: Он не гонщик, поэтому после as if нужна прошедшая форма were (нереальное сравнение).
